questions.q: when I fat-finger a subcommand name, where does the "Did you mean this?" list come from?
questions.why: findSuggestions/SuggestionsFor build the list in command.go; the edit-distance helper ld() lives in cobra.go

questions.q: what happens to the remaining args once a bare -- shows up while it is still working out which subcommand you meant?
questions.why: stripFlags and argsMinusFirstX both break out of their loop the moment they hit "--"

questions.q: I want a parent's own flags handled before dispatch reaches the subcommand — what switch turns that on?
questions.why: the TraverseChildren field and the Traverse() walk that parses flags at each level are both in command.go

questions.q: if a parent and a child both define persistent pre-run hooks, which ones actually fire and in what order?
questions.why: execute() collects the parent chain and only runs the nearest hook unless EnableTraverseRunHooks (declared in cobra.go) is set

questions.q: how do a parent's persistent flags actually end up visible in the child's flag set?
questions.why: mergePersistentFlags/updateParentsPflags copy parent persistent flag sets into the command's own set

questions.q: what ready-made checkers exist for "takes exactly two arguments" or "at least one"?
questions.why: ExactArgs, MinimumNArgs, MaximumNArgs, RangeArgs, MatchAll and friends are all defined here

questions.q: if I never set an argument validator on my root command, what produces the "unknown command" error?
questions.why: legacyArgs in args.go emits it, and Find() in command.go is what calls legacyArgs when Args is nil

questions.q: how do I declare that two flags can't be passed at the same time, and where is that rule enforced?
questions.why: MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive writes an annotation, ValidateFlagGroups/validateExclusiveFlagGroups check it

questions.q: how do I make a flag mandatory, and where does the "required flag not set" error actually get built?
questions.why: MarkFlagRequired sets the annotation in shell_completions.go; ValidateRequiredFlags in command.go produces the error

questions.q: can I make tab completion for one flag only offer .yaml files instead of any file?
questions.why: MarkFlagFilename stores the extensions, the BashCompFilenameExt constant is in bash_completions.go, and getCompletions turns it into a filter directive

questions.q: what hidden subcommand do the generated shell scripts invoke to ask my binary for candidates, and how is that trailing number after the colon written?
questions.why: initCompleteCmd defines the __complete command and its Run prints each candidate then ":<directive>"

questions.q: how does completion tell that I'm typing a value for a flag rather than a positional arg, including the -abc= shorthand case?
questions.why: checkIfFlagCompletion splits on '=', pulls the last shorthand letter, and trims the flag from the args

questions.q: where does the "completion" subcommand my program suddenly has come from, and how do I stop it appearing?
questions.why: InitDefaultCompletionCmd builds it plus the bash/zsh/fish/powershell children; CompletionOptions.DisableDefaultCmd/HiddenDefaultCmd suppress it

questions.q: how do I push extra advisory lines into a completion list, and what environment variable makes them go away?
questions.why: AppendActiveHelp prefixes the marker and GetActiveHelpConfig reads <PROGRAM>_ACTIVE_HELP / COBRA_ACTIVE_HELP

questions.q: in the generated zsh script, what makes it stop alphabetising my completions and keep the order I returned?
questions.why: the script sets keepOrder="-V" on the keep-order directive bit and passes it to _describe

questions.q: which file emits the fish script, and how does that script preserve my ordering?
questions.why: genFishComp writes __<name>_requires_order_preservation and a `complete -k` registration for that case

questions.q: there seem to be two bash generators — where is the newer script that shells out to the hidden completion command instead of baking the command tree into the script?
questions.why: genBashComp/GenBashCompletionV2 emit a script that calls ShellCompRequestCmd at completion time

questions.q: the older bash generator lets me paste in my own shell function — where does that string get spliced into the emitted script?
questions.why: GenBashCompletion writes c.BashCompletionFunction right after the preamble and before gen()

questions.q: why does my CLI print a warning and pause when someone double-clicks the exe from Explorer, and how do I switch that off?
questions.why: preExecHook in command_win.go checks mousetrap.StartedByExplorer(); the message text and delay vars are declared in cobra.go

questions.q: how do I dump man pages for my whole command tree, and what decides the file names?
questions.why: GenManTree/GenManTreeFromOpts recurse over subcommands and join CommandPath with the separator plus section number
